text: Soviet and Russian processed cheese is made by melting rennet cheeses with tvorog, butter and melting salts at 75–95 °C into a homogeneous mass, sold as dense sliceable blocks such as the 'Druzhba' foil-wrapped bar or as soft spreadable pastes.
